title: Ukubusa Komoya Nelangabi
intro: Cabanga ngombuso lapho umoya ngokwawo uphendula khona kumbusi oyedwa, lapho amazwi ezidalwa ezincane kakhulu ayenesisindo, nalapho amandla angabonakali emehlweni avamile ayegcinwa khona ekhonza ngokucophelela. Lesi sibalo sazuza umbuso ongavamile kumuntu owandulelayo othandekayo, ephethe amandla phezu kwezinto kanye namajini. Kodwa igunya elikhulu lafika novivinyo olukhulu - futhi umzuzu wokugcina wawuzokwembula okuthile okumangalisayo ngesimo sokuphila nokufa uqobo.
clues: Ngazuza umbuso omkhulu kumzali othandekayo owayengumprofethi nenceku ka-Allah.
U-Allah wanginika igunya phezu komoya, ewuthumela emisebenzini yohambo lwenyanga yonke ekuseni.
Ngisho nezidalwa ezincane kakhulu zazikhuluma ngendlela engiyisebenzisayo, futhi ngangima kancane ukuze ngimangazwe ukuqaphela kwazo.
Ngalawula ibutho elikhulu lama-jinn, abantu, nezinyoni, bonke behlelwe ngezigaba ezihlelekile phambi kwami.
Umbusi okude weza ukuzongivivinya ngenselele enzima, futhi ngenza ukuba isihlalo sobukhosi salowo mbusi silethwe enkantolo yami ngaphambi kokuba isivakashi sisukume ngisho esihlalweni.
Ngaqhubeka ngimi, ngincike endukwini, kwaze kwaba yilapho isidalwa esincane somhlaba sisidla—kwaba yilapho kuphela labo ababengizungezile baqaphela ukuthi sengidlulile.

arabic: وَلِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةًۭ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا ۚ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing. (21:81)
